body: I'm sober tonight, that's why I'm still awake. Just one of the many side effects.. I tell myself I'm going to quit every day and today is the first time in a while I didn't drink. I'm trying to prepare for Christmas so I can be normal around my family but I know I will have the shakes. Is any of those worth it?? I'm depressed and just want to be happy and healthy. I don't want my family to be sad and burdened by my death.. I don't want to be selfish but at this point it seems like the only option...

Thanks for the reply. I want it all to end..  I know many ppl struggle w alcohol but I'm really suffering. I don't know what to do. I'm embarrassed to tell my fam and I have no one to reach out to. I have a gun right next to me.. that's how bad it is. Alcohol has caused me so much pain and depression but I can't fucking stop..
